intent_en: To illustrate the inverse relationship between job supply and salaries when unrealistic job expectations are promoted.
previous_intent: To illustrate the inverse relationship between labor supply and salary when unrealistic job expectations are promoted.
chart_support: Line chart showing an upward trend for Supply and a downward trend for Salary
evidence_note: The narration explicitly states the inverse dynamic ('supply rises and salaries fall'), which is visually confirmed by the chart where the Supply curve ascends while the Salary curve descends.
